subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

Drop names

options.text: Delete someone’s name from a list
Name famous people to impress others

solution:
The correct answer is **"Name famous people to impress others"**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The meaning of the idiom *"Drop names" is "casually mention the names of famous people one knows or claims to know in order to impress others"*
 
• Let's see an example-
 
 
• She's always dropping names.
 
 

So the correct answer is **Option 4.**
